security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU, when a write to mpmpdeleg CSR triggers a cascaded update of hspmpdeleg.pmpnum (due to the invariant mpmpdeleg.pmpnum + hspmpdeleg.pmpnum <= total_PMP_entries), QEMU incorrectly enforces the hSPMP locked-entry constraint on hspmpdeleg.pmpnum and rejects or clamps the cascaded update. Conversely, on a direct write to hspmpdeleg CSR, QEMU fails to enforce the locked-entry constraint and allows hspmpdeleg.pmpnum to be set <= the index of a locked hSPMP entry.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: mpmpdeleg write handler that calls a shared hspmpdeleg update helper which unconditionally checks (or unconditionally skips) hSPMP entry lock bits (spmpcfg[i].L) without distinguishing direct-vs-cascaded write context
security_spec.summary: mpmpdeleg write must cascade-update hspmpdeleg.pmpnum bypassing the locked-entry constraint, while direct hspmpdeleg writes must enforce it — conflating the two paths breaks hSPMP lock semantics and can expose locked hSPMP entries to vSPMP control
